title: Advanced Sentence Patterns for Emphasis
explanation: Advanced English uses patterns that add emphasis or link ideas tightly. Not only … but also joins two surprising facts (after Not only at the start the verb comes first: Not only was he late, but he also forgot the documents). So + adjective + that and such + noun + that show a result. The more … the more … shows that two things change together.
explanationPersian: انگلیسی پیشرفته از الگوهایی استفاده می‌کند که تأکید می‌دهند یا فکرها را محکم به هم وصل می‌کنند. Not only … but also دو واقعیت غافل‌کننده را به هم وصل می‌کند (وقتی Not only اول جمله می‌آید فعل کمکی جلوتر می‌آید: Not only was he late, but he also forgot the documents). So + صفت + that و such + اسم + that نتیجه را نشان می‌دهند. The more … the more … یعنی دو چیز با هم تغییر می‌کنند.

examples.english: Not only was he late, but he also forgot the documents.
examples.persian: نه‌تنها دیر کرد، بلکه مدارک را هم فراموش کرد.

examples.english: The film was so long that I fell asleep.
examples.persian: فیلم آن‌قدر طولانی بود که خوابم برد.

examples.english: It was such a good film that we watched it twice.
examples.persian: فیلم آن‌قدر خوب بود که دو بار دیدیمش.

examples.english: The more you practise, the better you get.
examples.persian: هرچه بیشتر تمرین کنی، بهتر می‌شوی.

exercises.prompt: Not only ___ late, but he also forgot the documents.
exercises.explanation: After Not only at the start: verb before subject.
exercises.explanationPersian: بعد از Not only در ابتدای جمله فعل قبل از فاعل می‌آید.

exercises.prompt: It was ___ a good film that we watched it twice.

commonErrors.feedback: Before an adjective alone use 'so': so long.
commonErrors.feedbackPersian: قبل از صفت تنها از so استفاده کن: so long.

commonErrors.feedback: The comparative of good is better.

exercises.explanationPersian: هرچه بیشتر تمرین کنی، بهتر می‌شوی: ساختار the more …, the better …

exercises.incorrectSentence: The more you practise, the best you become.
acceptedAnswers: The more you practise, the better you become.
The more you practice, the better you become.
exercises.explanationPersian: ساختار درست the more …, the better … است؛ تفضیلی good می‌شود better، نه best.

exercises.incorrectSentence: Not only he was late, but he also forgot the documents.

acceptedAnswers: The more you work, the more you learn.

exercises.prompt: Combine with "not only … but also": "She speaks French. She speaks Italian."
acceptedAnswers: She speaks not only French but also Italian.

She not only speaks French but also Italian.
